__doc__: Hand-added job calls, merged into js/data/job-calls.json by scripts/scrape-job-calls.mjs on every run (and by .github/workflows/apply-job-calls.yml when this file is pushed). Use it for locals we can't scrape (no `url` in job-calls.config.json) or to add a call a scraped page missed. Key = local number ("915") or, if that number covers more than one local, the slug ("l26-roanoke-va"). Each entry: an optional `posted` label plus a `calls` array; every call needs `text` (paste the posting verbatim), optionally `count` / `classification` (otherwise parsed from the text, else 1 / Journeyman Wireman), optionally `open_until_filled: true`. Manual calls run through the same new/edited/filled diff as scraped ones, so adding an entry posts it to Discord and removing it deletes that message. If the same listing later shows up on a scraped page, the scraped copy wins. Keys starting with `_` are ignored (this doc, and the example below).
